steps.title: Start with 2 boards and 2 panels
steps.instruction: Join 2 boards and 2 panels (A, B, C, D), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the DALFRED chair. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (board, about 13 cm), B (panel, about 60 cm), C (panel, about 60 cm), D (board, about 18 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
